name: Ino Yamanaka
source:
Ino Yamanaka is a kunoichi of Konohagakure's Yamanaka clan. Ino has fair skin, light blue eyes and long platinum blonde hair worn in a ponytail, with bangs framing the right side of her face. Ino is the only child of Inoichi Yamanaka and was a popular student during her time in the Academy. There, she met [url=https://vndb.org/c105095]Sakura Haruno[/url], who was teased by other kids for her large forehead. Ino defended Sakura from the bullies and encouraged her to embrace her forehead rather than hide it, becoming good friends with her.
